_comment: The log a mocked run reports. A mock site has no SAS binary, so a run here is JavaScript - and a JavaScript run that wrote nothing leaves the SAS Logs panel empty, which teaches a visitor that the panel does not work. These are written the way SAS writes a log: source lines with their numbers, notes, a warning, a process-time block. `noisy` is the failure-shaped one, `clean` is a run with nothing to report; each twin reports one of them at random, half the time. `{{program}}` is replaced with the program that ran.
